sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: FIX: PARKA kidsL102 directly supports the intended description very warm jacket with a hood. The applied question, however, asks what this garment is called generally, without specifying the dictionary entry being paraphrased. Very warm is an unbounded relative property, and a hood plus insulation can coexist with water resistance: RAINCOATL40 imposes no contrary temperature/hood restriction. COATL48 is a broad outer-garment definition varying by style/use, not an exclusion of warm hooded versions. Different primary descriptions support the intended association but do not demonstrate one uniquely true name for the whole literal condition. The SOURCE phrase unique best answer is weaker than the required exactly-one-key gate.
